title: Omarchy Jarvis candidate-eval case (A-028 v0)
description: One deterministic capability or regression case. v0 only supports oracle_type=unit-test-reference: the exact oracle IS an existing tests/ function, so running it already gives a side-effect-free pass/fail boolean. No live model judging, no desktop execution, no stochastic N-runs (those are A-031's job).

version.description: Bump when the case definition (not the code it tests) changes; a human Training Verify never bumps this.

kind.description: capability: does a candidate change improve a specific behavior. regression: does an accepted behavior still hold.

oracle_type.description: v0 supports exactly one oracle type; new types are a later assignment, not a silent schema extension.

execution_level.description: planner-only: exercises the JSON/tools planner with no execution. unit: exercises a pure function/module. Never 'desktop' or 'live' in v0 (out of scope).

mutation_policy.description: v0's unit-test-reference oracles are exact and side-effect-free by construction (mocked hyprctl/subprocess/Ollama); no other policy is defined yet.

owner.description: Case additions and promotions are Control Plane changes (see README Promotion).

protection_class.description: protected-regression: an accepted behavior; changing its oracle is itself a Control Plane change. candidate-capability: still exploratory, freer to revise.

reference.description: Exact dotted path to the existing unittest TestCase (and optionally method) that IS this case's oracle.

expected_result.description: v0's oracles are existing regression/capability tests that must currently pass; a case defined against a known-failing test would misrepresent CI's own signal.
